svg.title: Every answer LFM3-1.7B gave, one tile each
svg.desc: Ten horizontal bands, one per digit from 0 to 9. Each band holds all 1,000 sampled answers for that digit, one equal tile per answer, in run order down each column and then left to right. Basic color words use stand-in colors; off-palette and unparsed answers are beige. Black tiles fill much of the 0 and 8 bands, purple much of 7 and 9, and every band mixes many colors.
